meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are counts of veterans already receiving VA disability compensation, not claims, appeals or unmet need: a rating says how VA scored a service-connected condition, not whether a veteran needs a lawyer or could get a higher rating. Questions about a claim are for an accredited attorney, agent or veterans service officer.

changes.title: Version 2.0.0
changes.summary: The data holds 3,187 records. Three flag columns are no longer in the files. 20 columns (such as county and rating_100) are now in va-compensation-values.csv, as id, column and value rows; join it to va-compensation.csv on id.

changes.title: VA disability compensation by county first published
changes.summary: Veterans receiving VA disability compensation on September 30, 2025 (FY 2025) in every county, state and the US, by combined rating band, age and sex, with the FY 2024 count for comparison: 6,331,627 recipients in VA's county file.
